error_example:
AssertionError: assert 'Hello, World!' in <Response 13 bytes [200 OK]>
+ where <Response 13 bytes [200 OK]> = client.get('/')
solution: Flask responses are Response objects, not strings. Access the actual data using response.data (returns bytes) or response.get_json() (returns dict for JSON responses).
fix_pattern: Use 'assert b"text" in response.data' for HTML/text or 'assert response.get_json()["key"] == value' for JSON
code_before:
response = client.get('/')
assert 'Hello, World!' in response
code_after:
response = client.get('/')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert b'Hello, World!' in response.data
